3230.title: Maintenance runtime survives indefinitely pending requests
3230.rootCauseOneLine: A provider maintenance request that never settles permanently prevents the idle timer from being scheduled.
3230.proposedFix: Give read-only maintenance operations daemon-owned cancellation or deadlines, then retire their runtime; keep install/update commands on a distinct lifecycle.
3230.caveats: The lifecycle gap reproduced twice, but the original WSL2 npm process behavior was not independently reproduced.
